hotels.title: Stylish Edinburgh Stay in the Heart of Edinburgh Park
hotels.description: Set beside Edinburgh Park Station in the capital’s western quarter, this polished retreat places Princes Street, Murrayfield Stadium and Edinburgh Castle within easy reach by tram. Gyle Shopping Centre is nearby for designer labels and high-street favourites, while Corstorphine Hill offers leafy walking trails and views towards the Pentland Hills. Inside, sleek interiors frame an indoor heated pool, sauna and contemporary fitness centre. The onsite restaurant serves modern Scottish fare, and The Botanist at Edinburgh Park pairs seasonal small plates with craft cocktails beside the landscaped parkland
